integrity: The lower bounds are analytic: a sharp Euclidean comparison gives the quadratic constraint, and an exact local adjacent-edge lemma gives the subquadratic branch. The bundled exact symbolic checker verifies the dodecagonal facet geometry and all algebraic certificates. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The formula is proved only for the stated regular dodecagonal plane. It does not classify all regular polygonal norms or all absolute normalized norms with a phase transition at exponent 2. Bibliographic searches cannot establish absolute uniqueness.
title: Complete Gao-type profile of the regular dodecagonal Banach plane
